EmailTemplate.name: Service: AW Bounce Back Message
EmailTemplate.subject: Anchor Wallace Case # {!Case.CaseNumber}: {!Case.Subject} | [{!Case.Thread_Id}]
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Thanks for contacting Anchor Wallace!
Case #{!Case.CaseNumber} has been created and a Anchor Wallace Customer Care Specialist will respond to you as soon as possible. If you need to reach out to us again, please don’t change the subject line so we can easily reference your case number, which allows us to quickly access all your details together in one place.
Wait! What’s a case number?
We recently implemented Salesforce as our new Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. As part of this, any questions, feedback or issues we receive via phone calls or emails, will now be assigned a case number. This allows us to more easily pull up all communications and updates associated with your requests so we can follow-up quickly.
Habits can be hard to break, so don’t worry! We can still track any questions using your purchase order or sales order number. Your case number just gives us another way to make sure we are always providing great service.
The Anchor Wallace Customer Care Team anchorwallace@anchorwallace.com 1-800-533-3570 Option 3
